thread:
sam (Design): quick sync on the credentials drawer behavior after key creation/rotation/revoke. I pushed a new prototype: https://imgur.com/def456. Main questions: should the secret persist in a detachable drawer? how to handle revoke confirmation copy (soft-delete vs immediate), and small a11y nits.

jules (Frontend): initial thought: detachable drawer that slides out from right and can be re-opened from the keys list for 60s. Simpler than a persistent modal. Implementation caveat: storing the secret client-side for that duration - need to ensure it's ephemeral and cleared on tab close.

lee (A11y): ephemeral drawer ok but must be keyboard and screen-reader friendly. Ensure the drawer has role=dialog and focus management returns to the originating row after close. If we auto-hide after 60s, announce: "This secret will be hidden in 60 seconds."

marta (Product): ken, any signal from support about users wanting a re-open?

ken (Support): yes — users frequently expect a way to re-open the secret immediately after creation. But they also worry about it sitting visible later. A 60s re-openable drawer seems like a good compromise. Also a lot of confusion around 'revoke' wording — people think it "deletes" the key permanently.

olga (PM): on revoke copy: propose two-step language. Step 1: "Revoke key? This will stop all tokens issued with this key." Step 2: second modal: "You're about to revoke key <redacted>. This is reversible for 24 hours via Support." That would allow soft-delete for enterprise customers. Thoughts?

sam (Design): designwise I prefer limiting the cognitive load: show a single confirmation with a bold headline "Revoke API key" and a subline: "Stops all future use. You can restore within 24 hours." plus an inline link to the KB. Also add an undo in-place: toast with "Key revoked — Undo" for 30s.

jules (Frontend): undo via toast is easy. For enterprise private deployments we can hook the restore API. For hosted we need idempotent revoke endpoint. Also we'll disable downloads for revoked keys.

lee (A11y): ensure the revoke flow uses role=alertdialog for high-priority confirmation and that keyboard focus stays inside the dialog. The toast undo should be focusable and reachable via keyboard — don't rely solely on mouse. Use aria-live for the revoke toast with clear copy: "API key revoked. Press Undo to restore."

marta (Product): what about rotate UX? right now rotate immediately replaces the secret; users expect an overlap period. Could we present both old and new keys and let them switch traffic?

ken (Support): from tickets: customers ask for a phased rollover often. They want a short overlap window so they can update clients. A checkbox: "Enable 1-hour overlap: keep old key valid for 1 hour after rotation." defaults off for safety.

sam (Design): will add the overlap checkbox to the rotate modal and a short inline help: "Overlap gives you time to update clients; old key will expire after the chosen window." Also include a small timeline visual.

jules (Frontend): technically we'll need to support rotate API params: { overlap_seconds: 3600 } and surface the timeline in the UI. Also record analytics events: rotation_with_overlap true/false.

lee (A11y): timeline visual should also have a textual representation for screen readers, e.g., "Old key active until 2026-04-01 15:32 UTC." And keyboard users should be able to adjust the overlap with input + stepper, not only a slider.

olga (PM): agree. We'll default to 0 overlap for new users but prompt pro users at higher tiers. Need copy for billing implications? maybe call out that extra overlap may increase attack surface and billing won't change.

marta (Product): action items: Sam update mocks with drawer re-open affordance + revoke copy and rotate overlap. Jules add aria attributes + keyboard undo for toast. Lee to review a11y once PRs land. Ken will draft KB entries for: "How to retrieve a secret after creation" and "Revoke vs Soft-delete". Olga will confirm backend support for overlap restore window.

sam (Design): I'll get mocks by tomorrow AM and include contrast checks and the alertdialog state.

jules (Frontend): branching now: feat/keys-drawer-undo . Will add analytics events and safe storage expiration.

deploy-bot: build queued for branch "feat/keys-drawer-undo"  build 7901 started. :rocket:

ken (Support): drafting KB now. Will circulate copy options for the revoke message: A) "Revoke now  this stops the key immediately." B) "Revoke now  reversible for 24 hours." prefer B for enterprise.

lee (A11y): final nit: any icons in the drawer (download, copy, revoke) need accessible names and clear focus outlines. Also avoid relying on color alone for state.

sam (Design): noted. Thanks everyone — will post updated links once mocks uploaded. :thumbsup:
